images.caption: In 1922, the horse tram to Sloten (Amsterdam) was updated: it was no longer pulled by horses, but by buses. To avoid misunderstanding, each bus carried a large sign reading "TRAM". This bus-pulled tramway lasted for four years, after which the rail tracks were removed and the line was replaced by an ordinary bus. This photo was taken on 21 February 1922 in the Bosboomstraat, currently Andreas Schelfhoutstraat
images.alt: In 1922, the horse tram to Sloten (Amsterdam) was updated: it was no longer pulled by horses, but by buses. To avoid misunderstanding, each bus carried a large sign reading "TRAM". This bus-pulled tramway lasted for four years, after which the rail tracks were removed and the line was replaced by an ordinary bus. This photo was taken on 21 February 1922 in the Bosboomstraat, currently Andreas Schelfhoutstraat

images.filename: 2022 09 14 Hannings & Kahl point-setting system, Amsterdam CS.jpg
images.caption: A 3-way Hanning & Kahl point-setting system at Amsterdam Centraal station on 14 September 2022. It automatically sends trams arriving at stand A to the correct platform. The indicator on the right displays "Lijn 24, Spoor 4". The points are accordingly set to send the next tram, on route 24 to De Boelelaan/VU, into the platform 4 on the left. Meanwhile a tram 4 to RAI waits at platform 2.
